Container.Name: netsip-sms-bridge
Container.Overview: SMS bridge between Over the Wire / NetSIP and a Yeastar P-Series PBX. On the PBX add an SMS channel with ITSP "General" and point it at https://YOUR-HOST/yeastar/send and https://YOUR-HOST/yeastar/verify. The PBX requires HTTPS, so put a reverse proxy in front of the port below.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: HTTP port of the bridge. Point your HTTPS reverse proxy at this.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Stores the list of inbound messages already delivered to the PBX.

Config.Name: Yeastar API Key
Config.Description: Any long random string. Enter the same value as API Key on the PBX SMS channel.

Config.Name: Yeastar Secret
Config.Description: Any long random string. Enter the same value as Secret on the PBX SMS channel.

Config.Name: Yeastar Webhook URL
Config.Description: The Webhook URL the PBX shows on the SMS channel.

Config.Name: NetSIP Account ID
Config.Description: Over the Wire account ID, e.g. SRC12345.

Config.Name: NetSIP Numbers
Config.Description: Optional. Comma separated numbers to poll for inbound SMS. Empty = every number on the account.

Config.Name: Inbound Mode
Config.Description: poll = check NetSIP for new inbound SMS on a timer. callback = NetSIP pushes replies (needs Public Base URL and Callback Token). off = outbound only.

Config.Name: NetSIP Plus Prefix
Config.Description: true sends numbers to NetSIP as +61412345678, false as 61412345678.

Config.Name: Default Country Code
Config.Description: Used to expand local numbers such as 0412 345 678.

Config.Name: Public Base URL
Config.Description: Only for callback mode: the public https address of this bridge.

Config.Name: Callback Token
Config.Description: Only for callback mode: any long random string.
